items.name: AggregatedMetrics
items.summary: Aggregated metrics data from an instrument

items.name: Exemplar
items.summary: A measurement sampled from a time series providing a typical example.

methods.name: filtered_attributes
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the filtered attributes in [Exemplar].

methods.name: span_id
methods.summary: Returns the ID of the span that was active during the measurement.

methods.name: time
methods.summary: Returns the time when the measurement was recorded.

methods.name: trace_id
methods.summary: Returns the ID of the trace the active span belonged to during the measurement.

items.name: ExponentialBucket
items.summary: A set of bucket counts, encoded in a contiguous array of counts.

methods.name: counts
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the counts.

methods.name: offset
methods.summary: Returns the bucket index of the first entry in the counts vec.

items.name: ExponentialHistogram
items.summary: The histogram of all measurements of values from an instrument.

methods.name: data_points
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the [ExponentialHistogramDataPoint]s in [ExponentialHistogram].

methods.name: start_time
methods.summary: Returns the time when the time series was started.

methods.name: temporality
methods.summary: Returns the temporality describing if the aggregation is reported as the change from the last report time, or the cumulative changes since a fixed start time.

methods.name: time
methods.summary: Returns the time when the time series was recorded.

items.name: ExponentialHistogramDataPoint
items.summary: A single exponential histogram data point in a time series.

methods.name: attributes
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the attributes in [ExponentialHistogramDataPoint].

methods.name: count
methods.summary: Returns the number of updates this histogram has been calculated with.

methods.name: exemplars
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the exemplars in [ExponentialHistogramDataPoint].

methods.name: max
methods.summary: Returns the maximum value recorded.

methods.name: min
methods.summary: Returns the minimum value recorded.

methods.name: negative_bucket
methods.summary: Returns the range of negative value bucket counts.

methods.name: positive_bucket
methods.summary: Returns the range of positive value bucket counts.

methods.name: scale
methods.summary: Returns the resolution of the histogram.

methods.name: sum
methods.summary: Returns the sum of the values recorded.

methods.name: zero_count
methods.summary: Returns the number of values whose absolute value is less than or equal to zero_threshold.

methods.name: zero_threshold
methods.summary: Returns the width of the zero region.

methods.name: time

items.name: GaugeDataPoint

methods.name: attributes
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the attributes in [GaugeDataPoint].

methods.name: exemplars
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the [Exemplar]s in [GaugeDataPoint].

methods.name: value
methods.summary: Returns the value of this data point.

items.name: Metric
items.summary: A collection of one or more aggregated time series from an [Instrument].

methods.name: data
methods.summary: Returns the aggregated data from the instrument.

methods.name: description
methods.summary: Returns the description of the instrument.

methods.name: name
methods.summary: Returns the name of the instrument that created this data.

methods.name: unit
methods.summary: Returns the unit in which the instrument reports.

items.name: ResourceMetrics

methods.name: scope_metrics
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the [ScopeMetrics] in [ResourceMetrics].

items.name: ScopeMetrics

methods.name: metrics
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the [Metric]s in [ScopeMetrics].

methods.name: scope
methods.summary: Returns a reference to the [InstrumentationScope] in [ScopeMetrics].
